text:
Alex: Heads up — planning to onboard 'advisor-3b' to the model catalog tonight. Need a quick ops check + rollback plan. Target deploy 21:00 UTC. Who can be on call?
Maria: I can be on the deploy. 21:00 works for me. What are the required smoke checks?
Sam: I'll own canary routing + smoke. Checklist off the top: model pinned in catalog, canary weight 5%, logging + traces enabled, perf guardrails in place.
Ken: PR #4567 merged to main but staging needs a smoke run. @deploy-bot can you queue staging?
deploy-bot: Staging run queued: run/789 — logs https://ci.redwood/run/789 :white_check_mark:
Julie: Quick note — advisor-3b uses the new quant config q8_4. Runtime flag needed:
```
--quant=q8_4
--kv-cache-enabled=true
```
Sam: Perf baseline from staging: p50 ~70ms, p95 ~240ms on short seq. If we see >2x p95 in prod, trigger rollback.
Maria: Rollback plan: alias swap back to advisor-2b, scale canary to 0, purge prefix/KV caches. Who can do the alias swap?
Alex: I can do the alias swap. I'll also handle posting rollforward steps and notify infra for extra GPUs during initial surge.
Ken: Staging smoke result: small prompts, embeddings, and a function-call test all passed. No OOMs in the logs.
Sam: Canary scheduled for 21:10 UTC with 5% traffic. I'll monitor traces, error budget, and response quality.
Julie: :thumbsup: I'll monitor the cost dashboard and pg stats for token spikes.
Maria: Code review: left one minor comment on sample prompts in the PR, nothing blocking.
Alex: Deploy command I'll run at T-2:30: 
```
redwood deploy --model advisor-3b --slot canary --weight 5 --quant q8_4 --pin-version v2026-03-18
```
Ken: Note: make sure model profile in catalog has the new seq-length limit set to 2048, otherwise runtime will fallback.
Sam: Agreed. Alert rule already added: >2% 5xx or latency >2x baseline => pager to eng-oncall.
Alex: Ok rolling at 21:00 UTC. Ping here when canary is live. If we hit the guardrails we'll swap alias immediately.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: deploy/3421 — live in canary slot. Streaming logs: https://ci.redwood/deploy/3421
Ken: Canary up at 21:12 UTC, initial 5% traffic flowing. No errors in first 100 requests.
Sam: Traces look clean, tail latency stable. Error rate 0.4% (within threshold).
Julie: Cost impact small so far. No anomalies.
Maria: Running functional prompt set now — samples look on-par with advisor-2b.
Alex: Canary healthy at 21:25 UTC. No regressions. I'll move to 50% at 21:40 if this remains stable. Will post back after the 50% window.
Sam: I'll keep monitoring until midnight.
Alex: Thanks everyone — great coordination. If anyone needs to follow up file a quick postmortem in #eng-ml later. Closing the thread once we hit 50%.
